The key insight is that `OnOpcode` in the objdump reader pushes an `InitInst` for **any** opcode except `End`. But `type` is only set for `i32.const`, `i64.const`, `f32.const`, `f64.const`, and `global.get`.

So if the init expr contains an opcode like `ref.null`, `ref.func`, `v128.const`, `i32.add`, etc., then `insts.size()` will be 1 (or more) but `type` will be uninitialized.
